title.en: Which pump is named for a house without a motor supply?
title.zh: 没有电机电源的住宅，点名的是哪一台泵？

description.en: The Rural Diesel Concrete Pump: 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, 800 kg.
description.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵：17 kW、5–8 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、骨料 1–3 cm、800 kg。

h1.en: Which pump is named for a house without a motor supply?
h1.zh: 没有电机电源的住宅，点名的是哪一台泵？

directAnswer.en: The rural self-built house diesel pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai names it that way and prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, horizontal 30–50 m, vertical 10–30 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.2 m³, 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and 800 kg. The application lines are rural houses, small sites, secondary structure and short-to-medium pipelines. Electric 15’s 60–80 m horizontal cell does not move onto this diesel row.
directAnswer.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵。邢台河北品锦机械就是这样命名的，并印了 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、15 MPa、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、骨料 1–3 cm、料斗 0.2 m³、外形 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm、800 kg。应用句是农村住宅、小型工地、二次结构和中短距离管路。电动15的水平 60–80 m 不能搬到这台柴油泵上。

heading.en: Diesel 30 is the next trailer, not a rename
heading.zh: 柴油30是下一台拖泵，不是改名

body.en: Diesel 30 is 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 60 m / 180 m and 2000 kg. Open it when the house line has left 30–50 m horizontal or 5–8 m³/h. A 17 kW match should not be written up as a 56 kW trailer.
body.zh: 柴油30是 56 kW、15 m³/h、60 m / 180 m、2000 kg。住宅管路离开水平 30–50 m 或 5–8 m³/h 时再打开它。对得上 17 kW 的工况，不要写成 56 kW 拖泵。

heading.en: The tractor 4100 is the other house diesel path
heading.zh: 拖拉机带动4100是另一条住宅柴油路径

body.en: It prints a wider 40–100 m / 15–45 m window, 6–12 m³/h, 40 kW and slump 180–220 mm at 1300 kg. Choose it when those cells are the ones you measured. The 17 kW pump remains the named compact diesel.
body.zh: 它印了更宽的 40–100 m / 15–45 m、6–12 m³/h、40 kW、坍落度 180–220 mm、1300 kg。你量到的是这些格子时选它。17 kW 泵仍然是点名的紧凑柴油机。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say there is no supply for a 15 kW electric motor, and give the pipe lengths. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明没有 15 kW 电机的电源，并给出管路长度。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does this pump print 17 kW as a motor or a diesel engine?
question.zh: 这台泵的 17 kW 是电机还是柴油机？

answer.en: The specification label is diesel engine power, 17 kW. The product is the rural diesel pump.
answer.zh: 规格标注是柴油机功率 17 kW。产品是农村柴油泵。

answer.en: Electric 15 does not print an outlet-pressure cell. 15 MPa is on this diesel page and on the 4100.
answer.zh: 电动15没有出口压力格。15 MPa 在这台柴油页和 4100 上。
